say:0:1222201001:0.text: Am I doing this right... Oh no! My bait!
say:0:1222201001:0.source_cn: 鱼竿是这样甩的吗……哎呀，不对，我的鱼饵！

say:1:1222201002:0.text: Is that scholar over there fishing? She looks flustered.
say:1:1222201002:0.source_cn: 前面那位学者是在钓鱼吗？怎么看上去手忙脚乱的。

say:2:1222202001:1.text: Sorry, I've taken this spot. You need to find another place if you want to fish.
say:2:1222202001:1.source_cn: 抱歉，这里的位置被我先占了，想钓鱼的话去其他地方吧。

choice_prompt:3:1222202001.text: Sorry, I've taken this spot. You need to find another place if you want to fish.
choice_prompt:3:1222202001.source_cn: 抱歉，这里的位置被我先占了，想钓鱼的话去其他地方吧。

say:5:1222202004:1.text: *Sigh* I just don't get why a fishing rookie like me was picked to be the assistant to a fish expert...
say:5:1222202004:1.source_cn: 唉，真是想不通，学会干嘛要派我这个钓鱼新手来当鱼类专家...

say:6:1222202005:1.text: Oh? Is this your first time fishing?

say:7:1222202006:1.text: Exactly! I used to investigate ruins before I injured my leg. As I can no longer travel far, the Conservatory assigned me as a temporary assistant to an expert in town.
say:7:1222202006:1.source_cn: 完全没有！我本来是遗迹考察员，但不小心摔伤了腿，不能远...

say:8:1222202007:1.text: At first, I was only helping him with some simple experiments... But recently, he suddenly assigned me a fishing task and handed me a long list of things to catch... I don't know anything about fishing!
say:8:1222202007:1.source_cn: 本来只是帮他进行一些简单实验……可是他最近突然让我来钓...

say:9:1222202008:1.text: You must know how to fish, right? Could you show me how to do it?
say:9:1222202008:1.source_cn: 说起来，你们应该会钓鱼吧！可不可以教教我，给我示范一下？

say:10:1222202009:1.text: I really, really need your help! Pretty please!
say:10:1222202009:1.source_cn: 我真的非常非常需要你们的帮助！拜托啦！！

say:12:1222202003:1.text: If you spent an entire day here and caught nothing, you'd probably be even more upset than me.
say:12:1222202003:1.source_cn: 换成是你，在河边干坐一天却没钓到半条鱼，恐怕会比我更郁闷。
say:12:1222202003:1.male: If you spent an entire day here and caught nothing, you'd probably be even more upset than me.
say:12:1222202003:1.female: If you spent an entire day here and caught nothing, you'd probably be even more upset than me.

say:1:1222203001:1.text: I see... Not only do I need to use my arm muscles, but I also need to keep my upper body straight when casting the rod. And I shouldn't put too much bait on the hook either...
say:1:1222203001:1.source_cn: 原来是这样……抛竿的时候不仅要手臂发力，上半身也得挺直...

say:2:1222203002:1.text: Thanks for the demonstration. I believe I won't go home empty-handed today! I even feel confident enough to catch everything on the list!
say:2:1222203002:1.source_cn: 多谢你的示范，这下我总算不用担心今天会空手而归了！我甚...
say:2:1222203002:1.male: Thanks for the demonstration. I believe I won't go home empty-handed today! I even feel confident enough to catch everything on the list!
say:2:1222203002:1.female: Thanks for the demonstration. I believe I won't go home empty-handed today! I even feel confident enough to catch everything on the list!

say:3:1222203003:1.text: However, the list also includes some saltwater fish. With my leg injury, I'm afraid traveling to the beach is beyond my ability...
say:3:1222203003:1.source_cn: 不过，清单上也有一些海鱼，但我的腿伤还没有恢复，想去海...

Oh, and they must be <style="highlight">freshly caught and still alive</style>!

say:0:1222204001:0.text: We've got everything Leonor needs! Let's go back and give the fish to her.
say:0:1222204001:0.source_cn: 莱诺曼小姐需要的四条鱼都钓到了，现在就回去交给她吧。

say:1:1222205001:1.text: That was fast! Wow... I sure am a novice compared to you.
say:1:1222205001:1.source_cn: 这么快就全部钓到了？！哇……和你比起来，我果然还是个钓...
say:1:1222205001:1.male: That was fast! Wow... I sure am a novice compared to you.
say:1:1222205001:1.female: That was fast! Wow... I sure am a novice compared to you.

say:2:1222205002:1.text: I really appreciate your help! At least I get to complete my first task...
say:2:1222205002:1.source_cn: 还是要谢谢你的帮忙。不管怎么样，至少我顺利完成了给我安...
say:2:1222205002:1.male: I really appreciate your help! At least I get to complete my first task...
say:2:1222205002:1.female: I really appreciate your help! At least I get to complete my first task...

say:3:1222205003:1.text: By the way, the expert is planning to set up a fishing club in Rustport, and he wants me to recruit veteran fishermen as members.
say:3:1222205003:1.source_cn: 对了，那位专家准备在锈锚港办一个钓鱼协会，让我留意附近...

say:4:1222205004:1.text: I wasn't going to do anything about it at first... but I see you're a promising and helpful fisherman. You'd be a perfect fit for the society.
say:4:1222205004:1.source_cn: 虽然我本来没打算干这事的……不过你很有潜力，而且乐于助...
say:4:1222205004:1.male: I wasn't going to do anything about it at first... but I see you're a promising and helpful fisherman. You'd be a perfect fit for the society.
say:4:1222205004:1.female: I wasn't going to do anything about it at first... but I see you're a promising and helpful fisherman. You'd be a perfect fit for the society.

say:5:1222205005:1.text: The society has a temporary office in the market of Rustport. Check out the place when you're free!
say:5:1222205005:1.source_cn: 协会地点暂时定在锈锚港的城中集市。等你有空了，可以过去看看！
